title: Objective
body:
Describe the purpose, scope, and intended audience of this document. State that this document serves as the basis for hardware requirements, design specifications, safety requirements, and cybersecurity requirements. / 描述本文件的目的、範圍和預期讀者。說明本文件是作為硬體需求、設計規範、安全要求及網路安全要求規格的依據。

文件流向須可追溯：RD-03-005 TARA → RD-03-103 System Requirement Management → 系統層級工作產出 → RD-03-010 硬體文件集。

The document flow shall be traceable from RD-03-005 TARA to RD-03-103 System Requirement Management, then to system work products and this RD-03-010 hardware document set.

安全與網路安全硬體需求由高階 SR、TSR、TARA 與網路安全目標推導，並決定元件層級之安全/網路安全目標。

The safety and cybersecurity hardware requirements are derived from high-level SR, TSR, TARA, and cybersecurity goals, and determine the safety/security goals at the component level.

The safety hardware requirements are derived from high level SR, TSR and determine the safety goal at component level. The hardware requirement and design is for IC design should include hardware architecture, basic design spec, HSR spec., HSI spec., and safety mechanisms.

The starting point is to perform basic design on the hardware level based on the system block diagram defined in the system design. In the hardware-level design, the hardware part classifies during the system design is developed into a function-level architecture diagram to create a hardware circuit diagram that meets technical safety requirements.

The hardware requirements have to be specified based on the hardware design and the technical safety requirements. The hardware requirements can be derived using analytic methods (e.g. FMEA).

In the hardware design result the hardware safety requirements which implementation the planned safety mechanisms.
